title: Satellite Node
not_satellite: This node is not configured as a satellite.
not_satellite_hint: To configure it as a satellite, set
not_satellite_env: in the node environment variables and restart.
enter_node_url: Enter the source node URL (e.g.: https://node1.com:8443)
enter_sync_url: Enter the source node URL to sync
snapshot_pull_desc: Download the current state of users and cards from the source node. This allows offline operation at the fair. You must run this BEFORE disconnecting from the network.
node_url_hint: The federated server URL of the main node. Include the mTLS port (e.g.: 8443).
sync_push_desc: Send offline transactions to the source node. Run this when you regain internet or intranet connection.
